notes: Shopify store (ellementry.com). Tier 1 curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131 worked for all HTML pages and products.json endpoints (plain requests session gets 429 bot-check, matching prior Home-Decor pass note). robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-ai disallow. Checked main header nav, mobile menu-drawer, mega menus, footer nav, and sitemap_collections_1.xml (472 collection handles) for Bestsellers terms. Header nav exposes a single top-level 'BEST SELLERS' item -> /collections/bestseller-2, with no dropdown/sub-structure (unlike e.g. Kitchenware which has a submenu) -> single undifferentiated listing, no genuine children. Verified via products.json?limit=250 exhaustive product-ID enumeration (161 unique IDs, single page, no truncation) -> exact qty=161, overriding the on-page 'Best sellers' banner mention (not used as source of truth per site's inflated-count pattern). Sitemap also contains an orphaned legacy handle /collections/bestsellers-1 (17 unique products, title 'Buy Bestselling Home and Kitchen Essentials Online in India', only 14/17 overlapping with bestseller-2) that is NOT linked anywhere in current header/mobile/footer navigation -> treated as a superseded/orphaned duplicate handle (same pattern the prior Home-Decor pass documented for this same site: dead alias collections still indexed by Shopify's auto-sitemap but not part of live navigation) and excluded, not reported as a second row. Site search modal's own 'Best sellers' widget (a curated 4-item promo list, not a full PLP) was checked as supporting evidence only, not used as the record.
